steps.name: Trigger ANR condition
steps.action: adb shell am start -n com.vasic.catalogizer/.MainActivity && adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP && sleep 1 && adb shell kill -STOP $(adb shell pidof com.vasic.catalogizer)
steps.expected: System ANR dialog appears after ~5 seconds indicating app is not responding

steps.name: Dismiss ANR and wait
steps.action: Tap 'Wait' on ANR dialog, then resume process with adb shell kill -CONT
steps.expected: App resumes to its previous state without data loss or blank screen

steps.name: Verify app functional after ANR
steps.action: Navigate to any media list screen and scroll
steps.expected: App responds normally, no frozen UI, no repeated ANR dialogs

challenges.name: Launch With Low Storage Below 50MB Free

steps.name: Reduce available storage
steps.action: Fill device storage until less than 50MB remains free, then launch Catalogizer
steps.expected: App launches successfully despite low storage

steps.name: Verify graceful warning
steps.action: Check for any low storage notification or in-app warning
steps.expected: App displays a non-blocking warning about low storage rather than crashing. Core browse and search features remain functional

steps.name: Attempt cache write operation
steps.action: Browse media items to trigger image caching
steps.expected: App handles cache write failures gracefully, shows placeholder images instead of crashing with IOException

steps.name: Disable all network
steps.action: adb shell svc wifi disable && adb shell svc data disable
steps.expected: Device has no network connectivity

steps.name: Launch app
steps.action: adb shell am start -n com.vasic.catalogizer/.MainActivity
steps.expected: App launches and displays a clear offline state message instead of crash or infinite loading spinner

steps.name: Verify offline UI
steps.action: Check screen content for error handling UI
steps.expected: App shows 'No connection' or 'Server unreachable' message with a retry button. No unhandled exception dialog

steps.name: Restore network and retry
steps.action: adb shell svc wifi enable && tap retry button
steps.expected: App reconnects and loads content normally within 10 seconds

steps.name: Simulate system update pressure
steps.action: Launch app while system update service is running and system resources are constrained
steps.expected: App launches albeit potentially slower, does not crash due to resource contention

steps.name: Verify UI responsiveness
steps.action: Navigate through app screens during high system load
steps.expected: App may be slower but remains responsive, no ANR triggered within 10 seconds

steps.name: Start a long operation
steps.action: Begin browsing a large media library or trigger a search with many results
steps.expected: Operation starts and data begins loading

steps.name: Force stop mid-operation
steps.action: adb shell am force-stop com.vasic.catalogizer
steps.expected: App process terminates immediately

steps.name: Relaunch app
steps.action: adb shell am start -n com.vasic.catalogizer/.MainActivity
steps.expected: App launches cleanly to home or login screen with no partial/corrupted state. No crash on startup from interrupted operation

steps.name: Navigate to deep screen
steps.action: Login, browse media, open a specific media detail page
steps.expected: User is on media detail screen with specific content

steps.name: Background and simulate OOM kill
steps.action: adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME && adb shell am kill com.vasic.catalogizer
steps.expected: App process is killed by system

steps.name: Restore from recents
steps.action: Open recent apps and tap Catalogizer
steps.expected: App restores to the media detail screen via onSaveInstanceState/ViewModel restoration. If restoration is not possible, app gracefully returns to home screen rather than crashing

challenges.name: Launch on Minimum Supported API Level

steps.action: Run app on device/emulator at minSdkVersion API level
steps.expected: App launches without ClassNotFoundException or MethodNotFoundException for newer APIs

steps.name: Verify core features
steps.action: Login, browse media, play media
steps.expected: All core features work. Features requiring higher APIs degrade gracefully with appropriate messaging

steps.name: Install and configure app
steps.action: Install current version, login, configure server URL, browse some media to populate cache
steps.expected: App is configured with user data, login session, and cached content

steps.name: Install updated version over existing
steps.action: adb install -r catalogizer-v2.apk (install updated APK without uninstall)
steps.expected: Installation succeeds without errors

steps.name: Launch updated app
steps.action: Launch app after update
steps.expected: User session is preserved (still logged in), server URL retained, cached data intact. No database migration crash

challenges.name: Clear Cache Does Not Lose User Data

steps.name: Login and use app
steps.action: Login, browse media, build up image cache
steps.expected: App has cached data and active session

steps.name: Clear cache from system settings
steps.action: Settings > Apps > Catalogizer > Storage > Clear Cache
steps.expected: Cache is cleared, SharedPreferences and database remain intact

steps.name: Relaunch after cache clear
steps.action: Launch Catalogizer
steps.expected: User is still logged in, server URL preserved. Images reload from network. No crash from missing cache files

challenges.name: Clear Data Resets to Clean State

steps.name: Use app with full data
steps.action: Login, configure server, browse media
steps.expected: App has user data, session, preferences

steps.name: Clear all data from system settings
steps.action: Settings > Apps > Catalogizer > Storage > Clear Data
steps.expected: All app data wiped

steps.name: Relaunch after data clear

steps.expected: App presents fresh login/setup screen as if first launch. No crash from null references to missing data. No stale state leaks

steps.name: Enter split screen with another app

steps.expected: App resizes to half screen without crash

steps.name: Verify layout adaptation

steps.expected: UI adapts to constrained size. No clipped buttons, no overlapping text. Scrollable content remains scrollable

steps.name: Enter unreachable server URL

steps.expected: Server URL field accepts the input

steps.name: Attempt login

steps.name: Verify retry possible
steps.action: Correct the server URL and attempt login again
steps.expected: Login succeeds with correct URL. Previous error state does not block subsequent attempts

steps.name: Simulate slow server response
steps.action: Configure network to add 30-second delay, then attempt login
steps.expected: Login request is initiated

steps.name: Wait for timeout
steps.action: Wait for client-side timeout to trigger
steps.expected: After reasonable timeout (15-30 seconds), app shows 'Request timed out' error. Login button becomes re-enabled. No ANR dialog

challenges.name: Login With Special Characters in Password

steps.action: Enter username 'admin' and password containing special characters: p@$$w0rd!#%&*<>"'
steps.expected: Password field accepts all special characters without escaping or truncation

steps.name: Submit login
steps.action: Tap Login button
steps.expected: Credentials are sent correctly to server. If password is wrong, error message shown. If correct, login succeeds. No JSON encoding errors or crashes from special characters

steps.name: Enable biometric login if available
steps.action: Configure biometric authentication in app settings
steps.expected: Biometric option is saved

steps.name: Fail biometric attempt
steps.action: Present wrong fingerprint or cancel biometric prompt 3 times
steps.expected: After max biometric failures, app falls back to password-based login without crashing. Biometric lockout does not permanently lock the app

steps.name: Login with password after biometric failure
steps.action: Enter username and password manually
steps.expected: Password login works normally as fallback. No stuck biometric state

challenges.name: Session Expires While App in Background

steps.name: Login and background app
steps.action: Login successfully, then press Home to background the app. Wait for JWT token to expire
steps.expected: App is backgrounded with active session

steps.name: Return to app after token expiry
steps.action: Open app from recents after token has expired
steps.expected: App detects expired session and redirects to login screen with message 'Session expired, please login again'. No 401 error toast spam. No infinite redirect loop

steps.name: Corrupt stored token
steps.action: Use adb to modify SharedPreferences XML, replacing the JWT token with garbage data: adb shell run-as com.vasic.catalogizer sed -i 's/eyJ.*/CORRUPTED_TOKEN/' shared_prefs/auth.xml

steps.name: Launch app with corrupted token
steps.action: adb shell am start -n com.vasic.catalogizer/.MainActivity

steps.name: Launch on rooted device or emulator

steps.expected: App launches. If root detection is implemented, a warning is shown but app still functions (no hard block for media browsing app)

steps.name: Attempt login
steps.action: Enter valid credentials and login
steps.expected: Login works normally. Root status may be logged but does not prevent authentication

steps.name: Login as first user
steps.action: Login with user 'admin' on server A
steps.expected: Login succeeds, media content loads

steps.name: Switch to different server and login
steps.action: Go to settings, change server URL to server B, login as different user
steps.expected: Previous session data is cleared. New server connection established. No stale data from server A displayed with server B session

steps.name: Verify data isolation

steps.expected: Only media from server B is displayed. No cached items from server A leak into the view

challenges.name: Play Media With Unsupported Audio Codec

steps.expected: App either plays video without audio and shows a codec warning, or shows a clear error message about unsupported audio format. No crash or silent failure

steps.name: Open corrupted media
steps.action: Attempt to play a media file whose container is corrupted (truncated, invalid headers)
steps.expected: Player shows clear error message like 'Unable to play this file' or 'File may be corrupted'. No app crash, no stuck loading state

steps.name: Navigate away from error
steps.action: Press back to return to media list
steps.expected: App returns to media list normally. Player resources are released. No lingering error state

steps.name: Start streaming media on WiFi
steps.action: Begin playing a streaming media file over WiFi
steps.expected: Media plays normally

steps.name: Switch to mobile data
steps.action: adb shell svc wifi disable (switch to mobile data mid-stream)
steps.expected: Playback may briefly buffer but resumes on new connection. If mobile data is unavailable, a clear buffering/offline message is shown. No crash from socket disconnection

steps.name: Restore WiFi
steps.action: adb shell svc wifi enable
steps.expected: Playback resumes smoothly. No duplicate streams started

challenges.name: Streaming Buffer Exhaustion on Slow Network

steps.name: Play media on very slow connection
steps.action: Throttle network to 50kbps and attempt to stream a high-bitrate video
steps.expected: Player shows buffering indicator. Does not crash or consume excessive memory trying to buffer

steps.name: Wait for buffer underrun
steps.action: Let playback continue until buffer is fully exhausted
steps.expected: Player pauses and shows buffering spinner or 'Slow connection' warning. Resumes automatically when enough data is buffered. No ANR

challenges.name: Seek to Invalid Position in Media

steps.name: Play a media file
steps.action: Start playing a 60-second video
steps.expected: Video plays normally

steps.name: Seek past end of file
steps.action: Drag seek bar beyond the end position or tap at the very end
steps.expected: Player seeks to the end and either stops playback or loops, depending on settings. No crash from out-of-bounds seek

steps.name: Rapidly seek back and forth
steps.action: Drag seek bar rapidly from start to end and back multiple times in quick succession
steps.expected: Player handles rapid seek requests without crashing, leaking memory, or becoming unresponsive

steps.name: Attempt to play DRM-protected content
steps.action: Open a media file that requires DRM license that is not available
steps.expected: App shows clear error message about DRM/licensing requirement. No crash from DRM exception. Player does not expose raw encrypted content

steps.name: Start playback with Bluetooth audio
steps.action: Connect Bluetooth headphones, start playing media with audio
steps.expected: Audio plays through Bluetooth device

steps.name: Disconnect Bluetooth mid-playback
steps.action: Turn off Bluetooth headphones or disable Bluetooth via adb shell settings put global bluetooth_on 0
steps.expected: Playback pauses automatically (Android AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY behavior). Audio does not suddenly blast through phone speaker at full volume

steps.name: Resume after reconnect
steps.action: Re-enable Bluetooth and reconnect headphones, then tap play
steps.expected: Playback resumes through Bluetooth audio. No duplicate audio streams

steps.name: Initiate cast to unavailable device
steps.action: Attempt to cast media to a Chromecast device that goes offline during connection
steps.expected: Cast connection fails with clear error message. Playback reverts to local device. No stuck cast UI state

steps.name: Resume local playback
steps.action: Dismiss error and play locally
steps.expected: Local playback resumes from where cast was attempted. Cast icon shows disconnected state

challenges.name: Deep Link to Deleted or Non-Existent Entity

steps.action: adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d catalogizer://media/999999
steps.expected: App launches and attempts to load entity 999999

steps.name: Verify error handling
steps.action: Wait for server 404 response
steps.expected: App shows 'Item not found' or 'This content is no longer available' message. Does not crash. Provides navigation to home screen

steps.name: Navigate deeply through many screens
steps.action: From home, navigate: Media List > Item 1 > Related > Item 2 > Related > Item 3 ... repeat 20+ times
steps.expected: App handles deep navigation without StackOverflowError or excessive memory consumption

steps.name: Press back repeatedly
steps.action: Press back button 20+ times to unwind the stack
steps.expected: Each back press returns to the previous screen in correct order. Eventually reaches home screen. No crash from stack depth

challenges.name: Intent Filter Conflict With Other Apps

steps.name: Open media URL that Catalogizer handles
steps.action: Open a URL matching Catalogizer intent filter when another app also handles same scheme
steps.expected: Android shows app chooser dialog. Selecting Catalogizer opens the content correctly. No crash from ambiguous intent resolution

steps.name: Enter split screen mode
steps.action: Put Catalogizer in split screen with another app
steps.expected: App resizes and redraws correctly

steps.name: Navigate in split screen
steps.action: Browse media, open details, go back while in half-screen mode
steps.expected: Navigation works correctly. Touch targets are still reachable. Content is readable

steps.name: Exit split screen
steps.action: Drag divider to make Catalogizer full screen
steps.expected: App smoothly resizes to full screen. No overlapping fragments or blank areas

steps.name: Enter PIP during playback
steps.action: Start playing a video and press Home to trigger PIP mode
steps.expected: If PIP is supported, video continues in small floating window. If not supported, playback pauses and app backgrounds normally

steps.name: Interact with PIP window
steps.action: Tap PIP window to show controls, then tap to return to full screen
steps.expected: App returns to full screen with playback continuing from correct position. No duplicate player instances

steps.name: Use gesture navigation near screen edges
steps.action: With Android gesture navigation enabled, swipe from left edge (system back gesture) while app has a side drawer or swipeable content
steps.expected: System back gesture takes priority. App handles the onBackPressed correctly. No conflict between app swipe gestures and system gestures

steps.name: Bottom gesture conflict
steps.action: Swipe up from bottom of screen during media playback (system home gesture area)
steps.expected: System gesture triggers home. Player properly pauses and saves position. No stuck gesture state in the app

steps.name: Trigger notification during first-run setup
steps.action: During initial server configuration/login flow, receive and tap a push notification that deep links into the app
steps.expected: App either defers the deep link until onboarding is complete, or safely interrupts onboarding and navigates. No crash from navigating to authenticated content before login is complete

challenges.name: Share Intent With Very Large Payload

steps.name: Send oversized share intent
steps.action: Send a share intent to Catalogizer with an extremely large text payload (>1MB) or many URIs
steps.expected: App handles the oversized intent gracefully. Either processes what it can or shows 'Content too large' error. No TransactionTooLargeException crash

challenges.name: Display Entity With Missing or Null Fields

steps.name: Load entity with incomplete data
steps.action: Navigate to a media item that has null/empty title, description, year, genres, or poster URL
steps.expected: App renders the item with placeholder text ('Unknown Title', 'No description available') and placeholder image. No NullPointerException or blank screen

steps.name: Interact with incomplete entity
steps.action: Tap on the entity to open details
steps.expected: Detail screen renders with available fields populated and missing fields showing appropriate placeholders. No crash

steps.name: Scroll to trigger pagination

steps.expected: Pagination request is initiated with loading indicator

steps.name: Simulate pagination timeout

steps.expected: App shows error at bottom of list with retry option. Already loaded items remain visible. No crash or list reset to top

challenges.name: Scroll to 10000th Item in Large List

steps.expected: App uses lazy loading / RecyclerView with proper view recycling

steps.name: Scroll extensively
steps.action: Fast-scroll through thousands of items using scrollbar or fling gestures
steps.expected: Memory usage stays stable (no linear growth). Frame rate remains smooth (no jank). Items at position 10000 render correctly with images

steps.name: Sort by a field with identical values

steps.expected: Sort completes without infinite loop or comparison error. Items with identical sort values maintain stable order. No crash from comparison contract violation

challenges.name: Filter Returns Zero Results on Every Criteria

steps.name: Clear filters

challenges.name: Rapid Sequential Searches With Zero Results

challenges.name: Pull to Refresh During Error State

steps.name: Restore network and pull to refresh

challenges.name: Display Very Long Text Without Truncation Bug

steps.name: Start loading on WiFi

steps.expected: Request is in progress

steps.name: Open a dialog

steps.name: Launch and browse app

steps.name: Navigate through app

steps.name: Block UDP traffic
steps.action: Configure network to block UDP port 443 (QUIC), forcing HTTP/3 to fail
steps.expected: Initial QUIC connection attempt fails

steps.name: Verify fallback
steps.action: App should fallback to HTTP/2 over TCP and continue operating
steps.expected: All API calls succeed over HTTP/2. No user-visible error. Fallback is transparent. App does not continuously retry QUIC and waste battery

challenges.name: Extreme Memory Pressure From Other Apps

steps.name: Create memory pressure
steps.action: Open several memory-intensive apps (browser with many tabs, games) to create system memory pressure while Catalogizer is backgrounded
steps.expected: System may trim Catalogizer's memory or kill it

steps.name: Return to Catalogizer
steps.action: Switch back to Catalogizer from recents
steps.expected: If process was killed, app restores cleanly via saved state. If trimmed, app functions with reduced cache. No OutOfMemoryError on return. Image caches are rebuilt lazily
